positions.title: VC
positions.description:
3VC was created in 2017 to invest in selected tech startups with proven product market. 

Starting from Series A, we focus on teams and opportunities with roots in DACH/CEE/Baltics and global ambition, both B2B and B2C.

Our team consists of experienced entrepreneurs, operators and investors and our Venture Partners bring experience from scaling companies such as UiPath and SmallPDF.

www.three.vc

positions.title: Social Business Angel
positions.description:
True evidence-based thinking is rare, especially in the charitable sector.
Effektiv-spenden set out to identify and vet the most impactful charities in climate change, poverty, malaria and more, and make them accessible to German donors.

positions.title: Member
positions.description:
I pledged to give 15% of my exit/IPO proceeds as founder to the most effective global charities tackling the climate crisis and other existential risks. 
The Founders Pledge team conducts extensive research and recommends the most impactful organizations based on the cause areas I care about.
